frozen_choices_summary.chronology_design: fixed 10-year history window (study's own first 10 union-years) then a fully held-out later period (all remaining union-years); non-overlapping, deterministic, no window search
frozen_choices_summary.outcome: OLS slope of log1p(Number) on Year over a constituent series' own Round-1 late window
frozen_choices_summary.outcome_eligibility_filter: series.late_year_min > max(study.hist_years) -- i.e. that series' Round-1 late window must fall entirely after the study's H4 historical cutoff
frozen_choices_summary.primary_statistic: RMSE(M0) - RMSE(M1), pooled out-of-fold across LOSO folds

support_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: primary permutation p > 0.05, regardless of delta_rmse sign; OR delta_rmse <= 0 regardless of p
support_rule.DIRECTIONALLY_OPPOSITE: primary permutation test rejects the null against the predicted direction (delta_rmse reliably negative)
support_rule.UNINTERPRETABLE_BLOCKED: fewer than 10 H4-eligible studies survive every gate
